name: Easy Slow Cooker Creamy Chicken-Black Bean Chili with Pickled Jalapeños

instructions.primary_message: Wash, dry, trim, and seed bell peppers; medium dice. Peel, halve, and medium dice onion. Place both in a 6-quart slow cooker insert along with enchilada sauce, corn, beans (with their liquid), tomatoes, and seasoning mix. Stir to combine the chili.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 medium yellow onion
2 (283 g) can red enchilada sauce
1 (432 g) can whole kernel corn, canned
1 (258 g) can black beans
1 (411 g) can diced tomatoes
1 (35 g) pkg chili seasoning

instructions.primary_message: Pat chicken dry with paper towels and nestle into the chili. Cover and cook until chicken is cooked through, low for 5 hours or high for about 2 hours.

Once done, carefully remove cooked chicken from the slow cooker and place on a plate. Using two forks, shred the chicken into bite-sized pieces, then return to the slow cooker. Add cream cheese and stir to combine. Set slow cooker to high and continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until cream cheese is melted and chili is warmed through, 10-15 minutes more.
To serve, divide chili between bowls and top with pickled jalapeños. Enjoy!
